cases.question: For each sector, how do total holding value and total recorded sector-allocation investment compare?
cases.reason: All 12 required sectors are present and every recorded sector-allocation investment value matches the ground truth, but the total holding value is incorrect for every sector. The added difference values are consequently also incorrect.

cases.sql:
WITH holding_totals AS (
                SELECT investor_id, sector, SUM(current_value) AS holding_value
                FROM ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HOLDING_001
                WHERE sector IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(sector) <> ''
                GROUP BY investor_id, sector
            ),
            allocation_totals AS (
                SELECT investor_id, sector, SUM(total_investment) AS allocation_value
                FROM ATOM_ENTITY_SECTOR_ALLOCATION_001
                WHERE sector IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(sector) <> ''
                GROUP BY investor_id, sector
            )
            SELECT h.sector,
                   ROUND(SUM(h.holding_value), 2) AS holding_value,
                   ROUND(SUM(a.allocation_value), 2) AS allocation_value
            FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p
            JOIN holding_totals h ON h.investor_id = p.investor_id
            JOIN allocation_totals a
              ON a.investor_id = p.investor_id AND a.sector = h.sector
            GROUP BY h.sector;

cases.reason: The pipeline groups by different risk-tolerance labels and reports totals that do not match the required Low, Medium, and High portfolio-risk bands.

cases.sql:
WITH holdings AS (
                SELECT investor_id, SUM(current_value) AS holding_value
                FROM ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HOLDING_001
                GROUP BY investor_id
            ),
            allocations AS (
                SELECT investor_id, SUM(total_investment) AS allocation_value
                FROM ATOM_ENTITY_SECTOR_ALLOCATION_001
                GROUP BY investor_id
            )
            SELECT CASE
                       WHEN h.risk_score < 33 THEN 'Low'
                       WHEN h.risk_score < 67 THEN 'Medium'
                       ELSE 'High'
                   END AS risk_band,
                   ROUND(SUM(o.holding_value), 2) AS holding_value,
                   ROUND(SUM(a.allocation_value), 2) AS allocation_value
            FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p
            JOIN ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HEALTH_001 h ON h.investor_id = p.investor_id
            JOIN holdings o ON o.investor_id = p.investor_id
            JOIN allocations a ON a.investor_id = p.investor_id
            GROUP BY risk_band;

WITH goal_status AS (
                SELECT investor_id, AVG(progress_pct) AS avg_progress
                FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTMENT_GOAL_001
                GROUP BY investor_id
            ),
            withdrawals AS (
                SELECT investor_id, -SUM(amount) AS withdrawal_amount
                FROM ATOM_EVENT_CASH_FLOW_001
                WHERE type = 'Withdrawal'
                GROUP BY investor_id
            )
            SELECT p.investor_id, p.investor_name,
                   ROUND(g.avg_progress, 2) AS avg_progress,
                   h.risk_score,
                   ROUND(c.withdrawal_amount, 2) AS withdrawal_amount
            FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p
            JOIN goal_status g ON g.investor_id = p.investor_id
            JOIN ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HEALTH_001 h ON h.investor_id = p.investor_id
            JOIN withdrawals c ON c.investor_id = p.investor_id
            WHERE g.avg_progress < 40 AND h.risk_score > 50
            ORDER BY withdrawal_amount DESC
            LIMIT 5;

WITH 
    scen AS (
      SELECT investor_id,
             COUNT(*) AS scenario_count,
             AVG(new_allocation_pct-current_allocation_pct) AS avg_scenario_change,
             MAX(new_allocation_pct-current_allocation_pct) AS max_scenario_change
      FROM ATOM_EVENT_SCENARIO_REBALANCING_001
      GROUP BY investor_id
    )
     SELECT p.time_horizon, ROUND(AVG(scen.avg_scenario_change),2) AS avg_scenario_change, ROUND(AVG(scen.max_scenario_change),2) AS avg_max_scenario_change FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p JOIN scen ON scen.investor_id=p.investor_id GROUP BY p.time_horizon;

WITH goal AS (SELECT investor_id, investment_goal, AVG(progress_pct) AS avg_progress_pct FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTMENT_GOAL_001 GROUP BY investor_id, investment_goal), 
    cash AS (
      SELECT investor_id,
             COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
             SUM(amount) AS net_cash_flow,
             SUM(CASE WHEN amount > 0 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS inflow_amount,
             -SUM(CASE WHEN amount < 0 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS outflow_amount,
             SUM(CASE WHEN date >= '2025-01-01' AND date < '2026-01-01' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS net_cash_flow_2025
      FROM ATOM_EVENT_CASH_FLOW_001
      GROUP BY investor_id
    )
     SELECT goal.investment_goal, ROUND(AVG(goal.avg_progress_pct),2) AS avg_progress_pct, ROUND(AVG(cash.net_cash_flow),2) AS avg_net_cash_flow FROM goal JOIN cash ON cash.investor_id=goal.investor_id GROUP BY goal.investment_goal;

      GROUP BY investor_id

    , goal AS (SELECT investor_id, AVG(progress_pct) AS avg_progress_pct, AVG(shortfall) AS avg_shortfall FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTMENT_GOAL_001 GROUP BY investor_id) SELECT p.risk_tolerance AS group_value, ROUND(AVG(cash.net_cash_flow),2) AS avg_net_cash_flow, ROUND(AVG(goal.avg_progress_pct),2) AS avg_progress_pct, ROUND(AVG(goal.avg_shortfall),2) AS avg_shortfall FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p JOIN cash ON cash.investor_id=p.investor_id JOIN goal ON goal.investor_id=p.investor_id GROUP BY p.risk_tolerance;

cases.sql:
WITH 
    cash AS (
      SELECT investor_id,
             COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
             SUM(amount) AS net_cash_flow,
             SUM(CASE WHEN amount > 0 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS inflow_amount,
             -SUM(CASE WHEN amount < 0 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS outflow_amount,
             SUM(CASE WHEN date >= '2025-01-01' AND date < '2026-01-01' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS net_cash_flow_2025
      FROM ATOM_EVENT_CASH_FLOW_001
      GROUP BY investor_id
    )
    , goal AS (SELECT investor_id, AVG(progress_pct) AS avg_progress_pct, AVG(shortfall) AS avg_shortfall FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTMENT_GOAL_001 GROUP BY investor_id) SELECT p.category AS group_value, ROUND(AVG(cash.net_cash_flow),2) AS avg_net_cash_flow, ROUND(AVG(goal.avg_progress_pct),2) AS avg_progress_pct, ROUND(AVG(goal.avg_shortfall),2) AS avg_shortfall FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p JOIN cash ON cash.investor_id=p.investor_id JOIN goal ON goal.investor_id=p.investor_id GROUP BY p.category;

WITH

      SELECT investor_id,
             COUNT(*) AS allocation_count,
             MAX(allocation_pct) AS max_allocation_pct,
             AVG(allocation_pct) AS avg_allocation_pct,
             SUM(total_investment) AS total_sector_investment
      FROM ATOM_ENTITY_SECTOR_ALLOCATION_001
      GROUP BY investor_id
    )
    , 
    holding AS (
      SELECT investor_id,
             COUNT(*) AS holding_count,
             SUM(current_value) AS total_holding_value,
             SUM(current_value-cost) AS total_holding_gain,
             AVG(returns_pct) AS avg_returns_pct,
             SUM(dividends) AS total_dividends,
             SUM(taxes_paid) AS total_taxes_paid
      FROM ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HOLDING_001
      GROUP BY investor_id
    )

cases.question: Across profile category, how do cash-flow net amount, scenario change, and scenario count compare using three related tables?
cases.reason: The pipeline uses different aggregations and omits the null profile category. It reports total cash and total scenario counts rather than the required average net cash flow and average scenario count, and its scenario-change averages do not match the reference.
cases.validation: Execution checks passed. Answer correctness has not been reviewed; use the separate grader.
cases.sql:
WITH 
    cash AS (
      SELECT investor_id,
             COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
             SUM(amount) AS net_cash_flow,
             SUM(CASE WHEN amount > 0 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS inflow_amount,
             -SUM(CASE WHEN amount < 0 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS outflow_amount,
             SUM(CASE WHEN date >= '2025-01-01' AND date < '2026-01-01' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS net_cash_flow_2025
      FROM ATOM_EVENT_CASH_FLOW_001
      GROUP BY investor_id
    )
    , 
    scen AS (
      SELECT investor_id,
             COUNT(*) AS scenario_count,
             AVG(new_allocation_pct-current_allocation_pct) AS avg_scenario_change,
             MAX(new_allocation_pct-current_allocation_pct) AS max_scenario_change
      FROM ATOM_EVENT_SCENARIO_REBALANCING_001
      GROUP BY investor_id
    )
     SELECT p.category AS group_value, ROUND(AVG(cash.net_cash_flow),2) AS avg_net_cash_flow, ROUND(AVG(scen.avg_scenario_change),2) AS avg_scenario_change, ROUND(AVG(scen.scenario_count),2) AS avg_scenario_count FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p JOIN cash ON cash.investor_id=p.investor_id JOIN scen ON scen.investor_id=p.investor_id GROUP BY p.category;

cases.question: Across profile segment, how do cash-flow net amount, scenario change, and scenario count compare using three related tables?
cases.reason: The pipeline returns totals and fixed scenario values rather than the required average net cash flow, average scenario change, and average scenario count by profile segment. It also omits the null profile-segment group.

cases.sql:
WITH 
    cash AS (
      SELECT investor_id,
             COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
             SUM(amount) AS net_cash_flow,
             SUM(CASE WHEN amount > 0 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS inflow_amount,
             -SUM(CASE WHEN amount < 0 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS outflow_amount,
             SUM(CASE WHEN date >= '2025-01-01' AND date < '2026-01-01' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS net_cash_flow_2025
      FROM ATOM_EVENT_CASH_FLOW_001
      GROUP BY investor_id
    )
    , 
    scen AS (
      SELECT investor_id,
             COUNT(*) AS scenario_count,
             AVG(new_allocation_pct-current_allocation_pct) AS avg_scenario_change,
             MAX(new_allocation_pct-current_allocation_pct) AS max_scenario_change
      FROM ATOM_EVENT_SCENARIO_REBALANCING_001
      GROUP BY investor_id
    )
     SELECT p.segment AS group_value, ROUND(AVG(cash.net_cash_flow),2) AS avg_net_cash_flow, ROUND(AVG(scen.avg_scenario_change),2) AS avg_scenario_change, ROUND(AVG(scen.scenario_count),2) AS avg_scenario_count FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p JOIN cash ON cash.investor_id=p.investor_id JOIN scen ON scen.investor_id=p.investor_id GROUP BY p.segment;

WITH goal AS (SELECT investor_id, AVG(shortfall) AS avg_shortfall FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTMENT_GOAL_001 GROUP BY investor_id), 
    alloc AS (
      SELECT investor_id,
             COUNT(*) AS allocation_count,
             MAX(allocation_pct) AS max_allocation_pct,
             AVG(allocation_pct) AS avg_allocation_pct,
             SUM(total_investment) AS total_sector_investment
      FROM ATOM_ENTITY_SECTOR_ALLOCATION_001
      GROUP BY investor_id
    )
     SELECT p.risk_tolerance AS group_value, ROUND(AVG(goal.avg_shortfall),2) AS avg_shortfall, ROUND(AVG(alloc.max_allocation_pct),2) AS avg_max_allocation_pct, ROUND(AVG(h.liquidity_score),2) AS avg_liquidity_score, ROUND(AVG(h.diversification_score),2) AS avg_diversification_score FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p JOIN goal ON goal.investor_id=p.investor_id JOIN alloc ON alloc.investor_id=p.investor_id JOIN ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HEALTH_001 h ON h.investor_id=p.investor_id GROUP BY p.risk_tolerance;

WITH 
    reb AS (
      SELECT investor_id,

cases.question: Across time_horizon, how do cash flow, scenario change, allocation concentration, and sector investment compare using four related tables?
cases.reason: The pipeline uses sums instead of the required average cash flow and sector investment metrics, omits the null time_horizon group, and its scenario-change and allocation-concentration averages do not match the reference values.

cases.sql:
WITH 
    cash AS (
      SELECT investor_id,
             COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
             SUM(amount) AS net_cash_flow,
             SUM(CASE WHEN amount > 0 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS inflow_amount,
             -SUM(CASE WHEN amount < 0 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS outflow_amount,
             SUM(CASE WHEN date >= '2025-01-01' AND date < '2026-01-01' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS net_cash_flow_2025
      FROM ATOM_EVENT_CASH_FLOW_001
      GROUP BY investor_id
    )
    , 
    scen AS (
      SELECT investor_id,
             COUNT(*) AS scenario_count,
             AVG(new_allocation_pct-current_allocation_pct) AS avg_scenario_change,
             MAX(new_allocation_pct-current_allocation_pct) AS max_scenario_change
      FROM ATOM_EVENT_SCENARIO_REBALANCING_001
      GROUP BY investor_id
    )
    , 
    alloc AS (
      SELECT investor_id,
             COUNT(*) AS allocation_count,
             MAX(allocation_pct) AS max_allocation_pct,
             AVG(allocation_pct) AS avg_allocation_pct,
             SUM(total_investment) AS total_sector_investment
      FROM ATOM_ENTITY_SECTOR_ALLOCATION_001
      GROUP BY investor_id
    )
     SELECT p.time_horizon AS group_value, ROUND(AVG(cash.net_cash_flow),2) AS avg_net_cash_flow, ROUND(AVG(scen.avg_scenario_change),2) AS avg_scenario_change, ROUND(AVG(alloc.max_allocation_pct),2) AS avg_max_allocation_pct, ROUND(AVG(alloc.total_sector_investment),2) AS avg_sector_investment FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p JOIN cash ON cash.investor_id=p.investor_id JOIN scen ON scen.investor_id=p.investor_id JOIN alloc ON alloc.investor_id=p.investor_id GROUP BY p.time_horizon;

cases.sql:
WITH 
    reb AS (
      SELECT investor_id,
             COUNT(*) AS rebalance_action_count,
             SUM(amount) AS total_rebalance_amount,
             AVG(target_allocation_pct-current_allocation_pct) AS avg_rebalance_gap
      FROM ATOM_EVENT_REBALANCING_ACTION_001
      GROUP BY investor_id
    )
    , 
    cash AS (
      SELECT investor_id,
             COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
             SUM(amount) AS net_cash_flow,
             SUM(CASE WHEN amount > 0 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS inflow_amount,
             -SUM(CASE WHEN amount < 0 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS outflow_amount,
             SUM(CASE WHEN date >= '2025-01-01' AND date < '2026-01-01' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS net_cash_flow_2025
      FROM ATOM_EVENT_CASH_FLOW_001
      GROUP BY investor_id
    )
    , goal AS (SELECT investor_id, AVG(progress_pct) AS avg_progress_pct, AVG(shortfall) AS avg_shortfall FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTMENT_GOAL_001 GROUP BY investor_id) SELECT p.category AS group_value, ROUND(AVG(reb.total_rebalance_amount),2) AS avg_rebalance_amount, ROUND(AVG(cash.net_cash_flow),2) AS avg_net_cash_flow, ROUND(AVG(goal.avg_progress_pct),2) AS avg_progress_pct, ROUND(AVG(goal.avg_shortfall),2) AS avg_shortfall FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p JOIN reb ON reb.investor_id=p.investor_id JOIN cash ON cash.investor_id=p.investor_id JOIN goal ON goal.investor_id=p.investor_id GROUP BY p.category;

cases.sql:
WITH goal AS (SELECT investor_id, AVG(shortfall) AS avg_shortfall FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTMENT_GOAL_001 GROUP BY investor_id), 
    holding AS (
      SELECT investor_id,
             COUNT(*) AS holding_count,
             SUM(current_value) AS total_holding_value,
             SUM(current_value-cost) AS total_holding_gain,
             AVG(returns_pct) AS avg_returns_pct,
             SUM(dividends) AS total_dividends,
             SUM(taxes_paid) AS total_taxes_paid
      FROM ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HOLDING_001
      GROUP BY investor_id
    )
    , 
    alloc AS (
      SELECT investor_id,
             COUNT(*) AS allocation_count,
             MAX(allocation_pct) AS max_allocation_pct,
             AVG(allocation_pct) AS avg_allocation_pct,
             SUM(total_investment) AS total_sector_investment
      FROM ATOM_ENTITY_SECTOR_ALLOCATION_001
      GROUP BY investor_id
    )
     SELECT p.risk_tolerance AS group_value, ROUND(AVG(goal.avg_shortfall),2) AS avg_shortfall, ROUND(AVG(holding.total_holding_value),2) AS avg_holding_value, ROUND(AVG(alloc.max_allocation_pct),2) AS avg_max_allocation_pct, ROUND(AVG(h.liquidity_score),2) AS avg_liquidity_score, ROUND(AVG(h.diversification_score),2) AS avg_diversification_score FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p JOIN goal ON goal.investor_id=p.investor_id JOIN holding ON holding.investor_id=p.investor_id JOIN alloc ON alloc.investor_id=p.investor_id JOIN ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HEALTH_001 h ON h.investor_id=p.investor_id GROUP BY p.risk_tolerance;

cases.sql:
WITH 
    cash AS (
      SELECT investor_id,
             COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
             SUM(amount) AS net_cash_flow,
             SUM(CASE WHEN amount > 0 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS inflow_amount,
             -SUM(CASE WHEN amount < 0 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS outflow_amount,
             SUM(CASE WHEN date >= '2025-01-01' AND date < '2026-01-01' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS net_cash_flow_2025
      FROM ATOM_EVENT_CASH_FLOW_001
      GROUP BY investor_id
    )
    , 
    reb AS (
      SELECT investor_id,
             COUNT(*) AS rebalance_action_count,
             SUM(amount) AS total_rebalance_amount,
             AVG(target_allocation_pct-current_allocation_pct) AS avg_rebalance_gap
      FROM ATOM_EVENT_REBALANCING_ACTION_001
      GROUP BY investor_id
    )
    , 
    scen AS (
      SELECT investor_id,
             COUNT(*) AS scenario_count,
             AVG(new_allocation_pct-current_allocation_pct) AS avg_scenario_change,
             MAX(new_allocation_pct-current_allocation_pct) AS max_scenario_change
      FROM ATOM_EVENT_SCENARIO_REBALANCING_001
      GROUP BY investor_id
    )
     SELECT p.risk_tolerance AS group_value, ROUND(AVG(cash.net_cash_flow),2) AS avg_net_cash_flow, ROUND(AVG(reb.total_rebalance_amount),2) AS avg_rebalance_amount, ROUND(AVG(scen.avg_scenario_change),2) AS avg_scenario_change, ROUND(AVG(h.risk_score),2) AS avg_risk_score, ROUND(AVG(h.goal_match_pct),2) AS avg_goal_match_pct FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p JOIN cash ON cash.investor_id=p.investor_id JOIN reb ON reb.investor_id=p.investor_id JOIN scen ON scen.investor_id=p.investor_id JOIN ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HEALTH_001 h ON h.investor_id=p.investor_id GROUP BY p.risk_tolerance;

cases.sql:
WITH 
    cash AS (
      SELECT investor_id,
             COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
             SUM(amount) AS net_cash_flow,
             SUM(CASE WHEN amount > 0 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS inflow_amount,
             -SUM(CASE WHEN amount < 0 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS outflow_amount,
             SUM(CASE WHEN date >= '2025-01-01' AND date < '2026-01-01' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS net_cash_flow_2025
      FROM ATOM_EVENT_CASH_FLOW_001
      GROUP BY investor_id
    )
    , goal AS (SELECT investor_id, AVG(shortfall) AS avg_shortfall FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTMENT_GOAL_001 GROUP BY investor_id), 
    holding AS (
      SELECT investor_id,
             COUNT(*) AS holding_count,
             SUM(current_value) AS total_holding_value,
             SUM(current_value-cost) AS total_holding_gain,
             AVG(returns_pct) AS avg_returns_pct,
             SUM(dividends) AS total_dividends,
             SUM(taxes_paid) AS total_taxes_paid
      FROM ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HOLDING_001
      GROUP BY investor_id
    )
     SELECT p.risk_tolerance AS group_value, ROUND(AVG(cash.inflow_amount),2) AS avg_inflow, ROUND(AVG(cash.outflow_amount),2) AS avg_outflow, ROUND(AVG(goal.avg_shortfall),2) AS avg_shortfall, ROUND(AVG(holding.total_dividends),2) AS avg_dividends, ROUND(AVG(holding.total_taxes_paid),2) AS avg_taxes_paid FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p JOIN cash ON cash.investor_id=p.investor_id JOIN goal ON goal.investor_id=p.investor_id JOIN holding ON holding.investor_id=p.investor_id JOIN ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HEALTH_001 h ON h.investor_id=p.investor_id GROUP BY p.risk_tolerance;

cases.question: Across time_horizon, how do cash flow, rebalancing amount, scenario change, risk score, and goal match compare using five related tables?
cases.reason: The pipeline includes three time-horizon groups but omits the null/unclassified group and its aggregated metrics. Most reported aggregates materially conflict with the ground truth, particularly cash flow and scenario change for every group, indicating incorrect joins or aggregation.

cases.sql:
WITH 
    cash AS (
      SELECT investor_id,
             COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
             SUM(amount) AS net_cash_flow,
             SUM(CASE WHEN amount > 0 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS inflow_amount,
             -SUM(CASE WHEN amount < 0 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS outflow_amount,
             SUM(CASE WHEN date >= '2025-01-01' AND date < '2026-01-01' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS net_cash_flow_2025
      FROM ATOM_EVENT_CASH_FLOW_001
      GROUP BY investor_id
    )
    , 
    reb AS (
      SELECT investor_id,
             COUNT(*) AS rebalance_action_count,
             SUM(amount) AS total_rebalance_amount,
             AVG(target_allocation_pct-current_allocation_pct) AS avg_rebalance_gap
      FROM ATOM_EVENT_REBALANCING_ACTION_001
      GROUP BY investor_id
    )
    , 
    scen AS (
      SELECT investor_id,
             COUNT(*) AS scenario_count,
             AVG(new_allocation_pct-current_allocation_pct) AS avg_scenario_change,
             MAX(new_allocation_pct-current_allocation_pct) AS max_scenario_change
      FROM ATOM_EVENT_SCENARIO_REBALANCING_001
      GROUP BY investor_id
    )
     SELECT p.time_horizon AS group_value, ROUND(AVG(cash.net_cash_flow),2) AS avg_net_cash_flow, ROUND(AVG(reb.total_rebalance_amount),2) AS avg_rebalance_amount, ROUND(AVG(scen.avg_scenario_change),2) AS avg_scenario_change, ROUND(AVG(h.risk_score),2) AS avg_risk_score, ROUND(AVG(h.goal_match_pct),2) AS avg_goal_match_pct FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p JOIN cash ON cash.investor_id=p.investor_id JOIN reb ON reb.investor_id=p.investor_id JOIN scen ON scen.investor_id=p.investor_id JOIN ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HEALTH_001 h ON h.investor_id=p.investor_id GROUP BY p.time_horizon;

requirements.original_query: Across time_horizon, how do cash-flow inflow, outflow, goal shortfall, holding dividends, and taxes paid compare using five related tables?

cases.question: Across profile category, how do goal shortfall, holding value, allocation concentration, liquidity, and diversification compare using five related tables?
cases.reason: The pipeline correctly reports five named profile categories with matching average goal shortfall, liquidity, and diversification values, but it omits the required null/ungrouped category and provides total holding values rather than the required average holding values. Its allocation concentration values also do not match the ground-truth average maximum allocation percentages.
cases.validation: Execution checks passed. Answer correctness has not been reviewed; use the separate grader.
cases.sql:
WITH goal AS (SELECT investor_id, AVG(shortfall) AS avg_shortfall FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTMENT_GOAL_001 GROUP BY investor_id), 
    holding AS (
      SELECT investor_id,
             COUNT(*) AS holding_count,
             SUM(current_value) AS total_holding_value,
             SUM(current_value-cost) AS total_holding_gain,
             AVG(returns_pct) AS avg_returns_pct,
             SUM(dividends) AS total_dividends,
             SUM(taxes_paid) AS total_taxes_paid
      FROM ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HOLDING_001
      GROUP BY investor_id
    )
    , 
    alloc AS (
      SELECT investor_id,
             COUNT(*) AS allocation_count,
             MAX(allocation_pct) AS max_allocation_pct,
             AVG(allocation_pct) AS avg_allocation_pct,
             SUM(total_investment) AS total_sector_investment
      FROM ATOM_ENTITY_SECTOR_ALLOCATION_001
      GROUP BY investor_id
    )
     SELECT p.category AS group_value, ROUND(AVG(goal.avg_shortfall),2) AS avg_shortfall, ROUND(AVG(holding.total_holding_value),2) AS avg_holding_value, ROUND(AVG(alloc.max_allocation_pct),2) AS avg_max_allocation_pct, ROUND(AVG(h.liquidity_score),2) AS avg_liquidity_score, ROUND(AVG(h.diversification_score),2) AS avg_diversification_score FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p JOIN goal ON goal.investor_id=p.investor_id JOIN holding ON holding.investor_id=p.investor_id JOIN alloc ON alloc.investor_id=p.investor_id JOIN ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HEALTH_001 h ON h.investor_id=p.investor_id GROUP BY p.category;

WITH 
    alloc AS (
      SELECT investor_id,
             COUNT(*) AS allocation_count,
             MAX(allocation_pct) AS max_allocation_pct,
             AVG(allocation_pct) AS avg_allocation_pct,
             SUM(total_investment) AS total_sector_investment
      FROM ATOM_ENTITY_SECTOR_ALLOCATION_001
      GROUP BY investor_id
    )
    , goal AS (SELECT investor_id, AVG(avg_volatility_pct) AS avg_volatility_pct FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTMENT_GOAL_001 GROUP BY investor_id), 
    scen AS (
      SELECT investor_id,
             COUNT(*) AS scenario_count,
             AVG(new_allocation_pct-current_allocation_pct) AS avg_scenario_change,
             MAX(new_allocation_pct-current_allocation_pct) AS max_scenario_change
      FROM ATOM_EVENT_SCENARIO_REBALANCING_001
      GROUP BY investor_id
    )
     SELECT p.investor_id, p.investor_name, ROUND(h.risk_score + alloc.max_allocation_pct + goal.avg_volatility_pct - h.liquidity_score + scen.avg_scenario_change,2) AS risk_pressure_score FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p JOIN ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HEALTH_001 h ON h.investor_id=p.investor_id JOIN alloc ON alloc.investor_id=p.investor_id JOIN goal ON goal.investor_id=p.investor_id JOIN scen ON scen.investor_id=p.investor_id ORDER BY risk_pressure_score DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH 
    cash AS (
      SELECT investor_id,
             COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
             SUM(amount) AS net_cash_flow,
             SUM(CASE WHEN amount > 0 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS inflow_amount,
             -SUM(CASE WHEN amount < 0 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS outflow_amount,
             SUM(CASE WHEN date >= '2025-01-01' AND date < '2026-01-01' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS net_cash_flow_2025
      FROM ATOM_EVENT_CASH_FLOW_001
      GROUP BY investor_id
    )
    , goal AS (SELECT investor_id, AVG(progress_pct) AS avg_progress_pct FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTMENT_GOAL_001 GROUP BY investor_id), 
    scen AS (
      SELECT investor_id,
             COUNT(*) AS scenario_count,
             AVG(new_allocation_pct-current_allocation_pct) AS avg_scenario_change,
             MAX(new_allocation_pct-current_allocation_pct) AS max_scenario_change
      FROM ATOM_EVENT_SCENARIO_REBALANCING_001
      GROUP BY investor_id
    )
     SELECT p.investor_id, p.investor_name, ROUND(cash.net_cash_flow,2) AS net_cash_flow, ROUND(goal.avg_progress_pct,2) AS avg_progress_pct, h.risk_score, ROUND(scen.avg_scenario_change,2) AS avg_scenario_change FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p JOIN cash ON cash.investor_id=p.investor_id JOIN goal ON goal.investor_id=p.investor_id JOIN ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HEALTH_001 h ON h.investor_id=p.investor_id JOIN scen ON scen.investor_id=p.investor_id WHERE cash.net_cash_flow>100000000 AND goal.avg_progress_pct<25 AND h.risk_score>70 AND scen.avg_scenario_change>20;

PREFIX wm: <https://wealth.example.org/ontology/>
PREFIX kg: <https://wealth.example.org/kg/>
PREFIX wmmeta: <https://wealth.example.org/metadata/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX w: <https://wealth.example.org/ontology/>

SELECT ?subject_iri ?action ?hasRebalancingLogic
WHERE {
  ?subject_iri rdf:type w:RebalancingAction .
  OPTIONAL { ?subject_iri w:action ?action . }
  OPTIONAL { ?subject_iri w:hasRebalancingLogic ?hasRebalancingLogic . }
}

  ?subject_iri a <https://wealth.example.org/ontology/RebalancingLogic> .
  OPTIONAL { ?subject_iri <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#label> ?rdfs_label . }
}

cases.reason: The pipeline correctly groups by the three non-null time horizons and provides inflow/outflow comparisons, but it uses totals rather than the required average inflow, average outflow, and average net cash flow. It also omits the null time_horizon group.

cases.sql:
WITH 
    cash AS (
      SELECT investor_id,
             COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
             SUM(amount) AS net_cash_flow,
             SUM(CASE WHEN amount > 0 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS inflow_amount,
             -SUM(CASE WHEN amount < 0 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS outflow_amount,
             SUM(CASE WHEN date >= '2025-01-01' AND date < '2026-01-01' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS net_cash_flow_2025
      FROM ATOM_EVENT_CASH_FLOW_001
      GROUP BY investor_id
    )
     SELECT p.time_horizon, ROUND(AVG(cash.inflow_amount),2) AS avg_inflow, ROUND(AVG(cash.outflow_amount),2) AS avg_outflow, ROUND(AVG(cash.net_cash_flow),2) AS avg_net_cash_flow FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p JOIN cash ON cash.investor_id=p.investor_id GROUP BY p.time_horizon;
